description: Centralized model-tier configuration for opencode-orchestrator-kit. Agent frontmatter references logical tiers ({{TIER_REASONING}}, {{TIER_CODE}}, {{TIER_FAST}}) instead of hardcoded model IDs. install.sh / scripts/apply-model-preset.py resolves tokens to concrete provider/model IDs at install time using the preset selected below.

tiers.TIER_REASONING: Deep reasoning / architecture / orchestration — used by orchestrator, oracle, security, planner.
tiers.TIER_CODE: Implementation, review, and test-writing — used by code-reviewer, developer-fixer, test-engineer.
tiers.TIER_FAST: Lightweight utility and high-throughput tasks — used by explorer, librarian, pc-doctor, npm-helper, build-helper, deploy-helper, writer, profiler.

opencode-go.label: OpenCode Go (default cloud router)
opencode-go.description: Default cloud router plus fast specialist endpoints. Mirrors the kit's out-of-the-box behavior: the router's flagship model for reasoning, and cloud-hosted specialist models for code and fast utility work.

local-ollama.label: Local Ollama (fully offline)
local-ollama.description: Runs entirely on a local Ollama daemon. Pull the models first: `ollama pull qwen2.5-coder:32b && ollama pull qwen2.5-coder:14b && ollama pull deepseek-coder:6.7b`.

commercial-api-anthropic.label: Commercial API — Anthropic Claude
commercial-api-anthropic.description: Standard Anthropic Claude configuration. Requires ANTHROPIC_API_KEY. Verify exact model IDs with `opencode models` before install, as Anthropic revises IDs over time.

commercial-api-openai.label: Commercial API — OpenAI
commercial-api-openai.description: Standard OpenAI configuration using GPT-4o for reasoning/code and GPT-4o-mini for fast utility work. Requires OPENAI_API_KEY.
